couplets.en: Today I will see them again.
Today I will see them again.

lines: Aasmaan ro raha hai do din se
couplets.en: The sky has been weeping for two days.

lines: Aasmaan ro raha hai do din se
Aap ne kuchh kaha suna hoga
couplets.en: The sky has been weeping for two days, so you must have said or heard something.

lines: Aap ne kuchh kaha suna hoga
couplets.en: You must have said or heard something.
Today I will see them again.

lines: Do qadam par sahi tera koocha
couplets.en: Your lane may be only two steps away.

lines: Do qadam par sahi tera koocha
Ye bhi sadiyon ka faasla hoga
couplets.en: Your lane may be only two steps away, yet even those steps will span centuries.
Today I will see them again.

lines: Ghar jalata hai roshni ke liye
couplets.en: He sets his house alight for a little light.

lines: Ghar jalata hai roshni ke liye
couplets.en: He sets his house alight for a little light.

lines: Ghar jalata hai roshni ke liye
Koi mujh sa hi diljala hoga
couplets.en: To burn his house for a little light, he must have a heart as scorched as mine.

lines: Kya pata uske baad kya hoga
couplets.en: I will see them again today, and who knows what will follow?
Today I will see them again.
